# Test documents

`lecture.docx`, `lecture-ja.docx`, `lecture-layout.docx`, `slides.pptx` were created for this project. The layout sample contains Japanese text, a table, an embedded PNG and a page break.

`legacy-simple.doc` is Apache POI's `test-data/document/simple.doc`, obtained from the official release tag:
https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/poi/tags/REL_5_2_0/test-data/document/simple.doc

Apache POI is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. The upstream release's license and notice are included as `APACHE-POI-LICENSE.txt` and `APACHE-POI-NOTICE.txt`.
